_provenance: 010 U2/R5 worth-it check. ~50 hand-labeled (query, document) pairs: a job-shaped query (intent vocabulary) paired with the library insight that should be retrieved for it (rule vocabulary). Used by evaluate_retrieval_geometry to measure the dedicated search_document: retrieval vector against the clustering-prefixed stopgap. Queries and documents deliberately differ in wording so the measurement reflects query/document asymmetry, the property nomic's search prefixes are trained for.

pairs.query: the login form keeps submitting twice on a fast double click
pairs.document: Precondition: a submit button can be clicked again before the request resolves. Action: disable the button on submit and re-enable in the request finally block. Expected outcome: a single request is sent per user intent and duplicate writes stop.

pairs.query: our retries hammer the API and make outages worse
pairs.document: Precondition: a transient downstream error is retried immediately in a tight loop. Action: back off exponentially with jitter between attempts and cap the total attempts. Expected outcome: load sheds during an incident instead of amplifying it.

pairs.query: timestamps are off by hours for users in other countries
pairs.document: Precondition: a datetime is stored without an explicit timezone. Action: persist every instant in UTC and convert to the viewer's zone only at render time. Expected outcome: times display correctly regardless of where the user is.

pairs.query: passwords show up in plain text in our logs
pairs.document: Precondition: a request body containing credentials is logged verbatim. Action: redact known secret fields before the log line is emitted. Expected outcome: no credential ever reaches the log sink.

pairs.query: the page is blank until every image finishes downloading
pairs.document: Precondition: render is blocked on loading all media up front. Action: lazy-load below-the-fold images and reserve their space to avoid layout shift. Expected outcome: first paint happens quickly and content is usable sooner.

pairs.query: search is painfully slow once the table got big
pairs.document: Precondition: a frequently filtered column has no index. Action: add a database index covering the filtered and sorted columns. Expected outcome: the query planner does a seek instead of a full table scan.

pairs.query: two users editing the same record clobber each other
pairs.document: Precondition: concurrent writers overwrite a row with stale data. Action: guard updates with an optimistic version column and reject mismatched versions. Expected outcome: the second writer is told to refresh rather than silently losing the first edit.

pairs.query: the app crashes when the server returns an empty list
pairs.document: Precondition: code assumes a collection always has at least one element. Action: handle the empty case explicitly before indexing into it. Expected outcome: an empty response renders an empty state instead of throwing.

pairs.query: uploads of large files time out
pairs.document: Precondition: a big payload is sent in a single blocking request. Action: stream the upload in chunks and resume from the last acked chunk on failure. Expected outcome: large transfers complete without hitting the request timeout.

pairs.query: the spinner never goes away when a call fails
pairs.document: Precondition: loading state is cleared only on the success path. Action: clear the loading flag in a finally block so it runs on error too. Expected outcome: the UI always settles whether the request succeeds or fails.

pairs.query: money math gives wrong cents on totals
pairs.document: Precondition: currency amounts are stored and summed as floats. Action: represent money as integer minor units or a fixed-precision decimal. Expected outcome: sums and rounding are exact to the cent.

pairs.query: anyone can open another user's invoice by changing the id in the url
pairs.document: Precondition: an endpoint trusts the resource id without checking ownership. Action: verify the authenticated principal owns the resource before returning it. Expected outcome: cross-account access is denied with a not-found or forbidden.

pairs.query: the cron job sometimes runs twice and double-charges
pairs.document: Precondition: a scheduled task is not safe to run more than once. Action: make the operation idempotent with a unique job key and a dedup check. Expected outcome: a duplicate trigger is a no-op instead of a second charge.

pairs.query: the form loses everything the user typed on a validation error
pairs.document: Precondition: a failed submit re-renders the form from defaults. Action: echo the submitted values back into the fields alongside the errors. Expected outcome: the user fixes one field without retyping the rest.

pairs.query: emails go out even when the transaction rolls back
pairs.document: Precondition: a side effect fires before the surrounding write commits. Action: enqueue the notification to run after commit, not inside the transaction. Expected outcome: no email is sent for work that was rolled back.

pairs.query: the chart shows stale numbers after I refresh
pairs.document: Precondition: a cached response outlives the data it summarizes. Action: invalidate or key the cache on the underlying data's version. Expected outcome: a refresh reflects the latest writes.

pairs.query: special characters in names break the csv export
pairs.document: Precondition: fields are joined with commas without escaping. Action: quote fields and escape embedded quotes per the csv spec. Expected outcome: names with commas and quotes round-trip cleanly.

pairs.query: the api returns a 500 instead of telling the client what was wrong
pairs.document: Precondition: invalid input is allowed to throw deep in the stack. Action: validate at the boundary and return a 400 with a field-level message. Expected outcome: clients get an actionable error, not an opaque server failure.

pairs.query: sessions never expire so a stolen token works forever
pairs.document: Precondition: an auth token has no expiry or rotation. Action: issue short-lived access tokens with refresh and server-side revocation. Expected outcome: a leaked token stops working within a bounded window.

pairs.query: the mobile layout overflows horizontally
pairs.document: Precondition: a fixed pixel width is wider than small viewports. Action: use relative units and a max-width with wrapping for narrow screens. Expected outcome: content fits without a horizontal scrollbar on phones.

pairs.query: deploys cause a brief window where the site is down
pairs.document: Precondition: old instances are killed before new ones are ready. Action: roll out with health checks and drain connections before terminating. Expected outcome: requests are served continuously across a deploy.

pairs.query: duplicate accounts get created when signup is slow
pairs.document: Precondition: a unique constraint is enforced only in application code. Action: add a unique index on the email column at the database level. Expected outcome: a race cannot create two accounts with the same email.

pairs.query: the test suite passes locally but fails in ci randomly
pairs.document: Precondition: tests depend on execution order or shared mutable state. Action: isolate each test's fixtures and reset global state between runs. Expected outcome: tests pass deterministically regardless of order.

pairs.query: users see someone else's data right after login
pairs.document: Precondition: per-user data is cached under a key that omits the user. Action: include the user id in every cache key for user-scoped data. Expected outcome: one user never sees another's cached content.

pairs.query: the background queue silently drops jobs under load
pairs.document: Precondition: failed jobs are discarded without a retry or record. Action: move exhausted jobs to a dead-letter queue with the error. Expected outcome: no work vanishes; failures are visible and replayable.

pairs.query: the date picker accepts impossible dates like feb 30
pairs.document: Precondition: a date is assembled from parts without calendar validation. Action: parse through a real date type that rejects invalid combinations. Expected outcome: only real calendar dates are accepted.

pairs.query: pasting rich text into the editor injects weird markup
pairs.document: Precondition: pasted html is inserted into the dom unsanitized. Action: strip disallowed tags and attributes through an allowlist sanitizer. Expected outcome: pasted content is clean and cannot run script.

pairs.query: the report query locks the table and blocks writes
pairs.document: Precondition: a long analytic read runs against the primary write store. Action: route heavy reads to a replica or a snapshot isolation level. Expected outcome: reporting no longer contends with live writes.

pairs.query: a failed payment still marks the order as paid
pairs.document: Precondition: order state is updated before the charge is confirmed. Action: only transition to paid after the gateway acknowledges success. Expected outcome: order status matches the actual payment result.

pairs.query: the search box fires a request on every keystroke
pairs.document: Precondition: each input event triggers an immediate network call. Action: debounce the query and cancel the previous in-flight request. Expected outcome: one request per pause in typing, not per character.

pairs.query: config secrets are committed to the repository
pairs.document: Precondition: credentials live in a tracked configuration file. Action: load secrets from the environment or a vault and ignore the file. Expected outcome: no secret is stored in version control history.

pairs.query: the infinite scroll loads the same page twice
pairs.document: Precondition: the next-page fetch can fire again before the first returns. Action: gate fetching on an in-flight flag and a stable cursor. Expected outcome: each page is loaded exactly once while scrolling.

pairs.query: deleting a parent leaves orphaned child rows
pairs.document: Precondition: a foreign key has no cascade or cleanup. Action: declare on-delete behavior or remove children in the same transaction. Expected outcome: no dangling references remain after a delete.

pairs.query: the modal traps keyboard users with no way out
pairs.document: Precondition: focus is not managed when a dialog opens. Action: move focus into the dialog, trap it, and restore focus on close. Expected outcome: keyboard and screen-reader users can operate and dismiss it.

pairs.query: rounding makes percentages add up to 101 percent
pairs.document: Precondition: each share is rounded independently. Action: round all but the last and assign the remainder to it. Expected outcome: displayed parts sum exactly to the whole.

pairs.query: the webhook handler is slow and the sender retries
pairs.document: Precondition: heavy work runs inline in the webhook response path. Action: acknowledge fast and process the event asynchronously. Expected outcome: the sender gets a prompt 200 and does not retry.

pairs.query: long usernames break the navbar layout
pairs.document: Precondition: a label assumes a bounded text length. Action: truncate with an ellipsis and expose the full value on hover. Expected outcome: the layout holds for arbitrarily long names.

pairs.query: a slow third-party call makes our whole page hang
pairs.document: Precondition: an external dependency is called without a timeout. Action: set an aggressive timeout and degrade gracefully on failure. Expected outcome: a slow vendor cannot block our own response.

pairs.query: the api leaks internal stack traces to callers
pairs.document: Precondition: unhandled exceptions render their trace in the response. Action: catch at the edge and return a generic error with a correlation id. Expected outcome: internals stay private while support can still trace the request.

pairs.query: two tabs of the app fight over the same draft
pairs.document: Precondition: shared local state is written by multiple tabs at once. Action: coordinate through a single source of truth with a last-write timestamp. Expected outcome: tabs converge instead of overwriting each other randomly.

pairs.query: the importer chokes on a file with a byte order mark
pairs.document: Precondition: the parser assumes plain utf-8 with no bom. Action: detect and strip the bom before parsing the first field. Expected outcome: files exported from common tools import without a leading garbage character.

pairs.query: users can submit the checkout while offline and lose the order
pairs.document: Precondition: a submit assumes the network is available. Action: detect connectivity, queue the action, and replay it when back online. Expected outcome: an offline submit is preserved and completes later.

pairs.query: the same email gets sent every time the worker restarts
pairs.document: Precondition: sent state is tracked only in memory. Action: record delivery in durable storage and check it before sending. Expected outcome: a restart does not resend already-delivered mail.

pairs.query: filtering by category also secretly filters out archived items
pairs.document: Precondition: a default scope hides archived rows everywhere. Action: make the archived filter explicit and opt-in per query. Expected outcome: callers control archive visibility rather than inheriting a hidden default.

pairs.query: the progress bar jumps backwards sometimes
pairs.document: Precondition: progress is computed from out-of-order async events. Action: track a monotonic high-water mark and ignore stale updates. Expected outcome: progress only ever moves forward.

pairs.query: a malformed query param takes down the endpoint
pairs.document: Precondition: a parameter is parsed without bounds or type checks. Action: coerce and clamp inputs, rejecting anything out of range. Expected outcome: bad input yields a 400, never a crash.

pairs.query: the cache grows without bound and the box runs out of memory
pairs.document: Precondition: cached entries are added but never evicted. Action: bound the cache with an lru policy and a max size. Expected outcome: memory stays flat under sustained traffic.

pairs.query: clicking export downloads an empty file when there are many rows
pairs.document: Precondition: the whole result set is built in memory before sending. Action: stream rows to the response as they are read from the cursor. Expected outcome: large exports start immediately and never exhaust memory.

pairs.query: the app shows 'undefined' in the greeting for new users
pairs.document: Precondition: a display name is read before the profile loads. Action: render a sensible fallback until the value is present. Expected outcome: users never see a raw undefined in the interface.

pairs.query: a single bad record aborts the entire nightly import
pairs.document: Precondition: the batch fails fast on the first invalid row. Action: process rows independently and collect failures into a report. Expected outcome: good rows import while bad ones are quarantined for review.

pairs.query: the rate limiter blocks legit users behind a shared office ip
pairs.document: Precondition: limits are keyed only on ip address. Action: key throttling on the authenticated account where available. Expected outcome: one heavy user does not lock out their colleagues.
